subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 4: Pyramid Volume Beyond Rectangular Bases
description: Apply the pyramid volume formula V = one-third base area times height to pyramids with triangular, hexagonal, and other non-rectangular bases, with emphasis on identifying the correct base area before substituting.
learningObjectives: Use V = (1/3)Bh to find the volume of pyramids with varied bases
Identify B as the area of the base, not just one base length
Distinguish perpendicular height from slant height in pyramid diagrams
Compute base areas for triangular, rectangular, and regular polygon bases before finding volume
Explain why volume is measured in cubic units
